title: In OpenStack Cinder before 29.1.1, by making an os-initialize_connection request with an IQN that includes a path…
description: OpenStack Cinder versions before 29.1.1 contain a vulnerability in the os-initialize_connection request handling for the LIO iSCSI target driver. An authenticated user with a 'member' role can exploit a path traversal in the initiator's IQN to create or overwrite files on the volume host filesystem. This affects only cinder-volume hosts using the LIO iSCSI target driver, commonly paired with the LVM volume driver.
